messages:
maria: Quick check — Sprint Orbit deploy tomorrow 09:00 PST. Final owners and rollback plan?
aj: I'll own DB migration and verification. Plan: run `scripts/migrate_v3.sh` at 09:05, then checksum. If migration >2min or checksum mismatch -> abort.
maria: Good. @aj post checksum here when done.
sasha: I'll own the frontend canary + smoke (start 09:10). Smoke will cover login, search, and model endpoints.
sasha: Smoke checklist:
```
1) GET /health -> 200
2) Login with test user -> success
3) Quick search "orbit test" -> results
4) POST /api/v1/generate sample payload -> 200 + coherent output
``` 
taylor: I'll be on rollback duty. Ready to run `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-server --to-revision=PREV` and revert nginx if canary fails.
maria: Canary traffic plan?
sasha: 5% for 10m, 25% for 5m, then 100% if no regressions. Auto-promote only if error rate <1% and p50 latency within 20% of baseline.
aj: DB migration quick checks: run migration, then `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE migrated_v3 = true;` and compare to expected. I'll post counts here.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 2249123456: Sprint Orbit (09:00 PST). Reserved slot + 1h log retention. :rocket:
maria: Contingency: if migration times out or search errors >3% during 5% canary, abort and rollback. Taylor will execute rollback and we will stop traffic.
aj: ack — I'll signal `migration:complete` or `migration:abort` in this thread when done.
sasha: ack — will post smoke results as `smoke:pass` or `smoke:fail` with quick notes.
taylor: ack — will be available 08:50–10:30 for immediate rollback.
maria: Great. Infra asked for one extra collector for the canary window; I enabled +1h retention. Anyone need changes in release notes or runbook?
sasha: I'll add a one-paragraph note about canary endpoints and test payloads.
aj: I'll attach migration notes after dry-run tonight.
maria: Perfect. Last thing — can everyone react with :thumbsup: if the plan looks good?
aj: :thumbsup:
sasha: :thumbsup:
taylor: :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks team — I'll post a quick calendar invite and update the release-train doc."
